_comment: Registry for scripts/vendor.py — the maintainer-run cross-repo vendoring sync tool. Paths are resolved relative to this file's directory (the LaTeX-shared-files repo root). Children never run the tool; it lives and runs here.

_consumers_comment: Master list of every repository that carries or links shared files (di-*.sty) and/or the master bibliography. Keep it current: add a consumer when a repository starts vendoring, mark it retired when it is consolidated. `python3 _scripts/consumers.py` checks the list against reality (pins vs upstream HEAD; unlisted repositories that vendor) and `--write` regenerates CONSUMERS.md here and in math-bibliography.
